name: vicem_create_baton
description: Creates a compressed U-Shaped Context Baton (.vicem/BATON.md) and symbol ledger (.vicem/ledger.json) from the current project session and git state. Use at session end or before quota limits to hand off work; do not use to read an existing baton (vicem_read_baton), restore a skeletonized function (vicem_rehydrate), or validate edits (vicem_check_guard). Compresses context by skeletonizing unchanged functions >=12 lines into .vicem/ledger.json while keeping signatures intact. Idempotently overwrites .vicem/BATON.md, .vicem/baton.json, and .vicem/ledger.json after saving a rollback snapshot in .vicem/snapshots/, with secret redaction and zero source file mutations (no auth or rate limits). Parameter semantics: goal overrides auto-extracted session intent in Section 1; targetAgent tailors receiver rules (default "codex"); budgetTokens (500-128000, default 4000) controls skeletonization depth. Returns the generated Markdown baton (isError=false).

goal.description: Optional explicit engineering goal override for Section 1 (e.g., "Fix JWT refresh race in src/auth.ts"). If omitted, inferred from active session history and git diff.

targetAgent.description: Destination AI coding agent identifier used to format receiver instructions (default: "codex").

budgetTokens.description: Maximum token budget governing how aggressively Tier 3/4 context files are skeletonized (default: 4000, range: 500-128000).

decisions.description: Optional architectural decisions or hard constraints to persist in .vicem/decisions.json at 100% salience across sessions.

compactAll.description: When true, packs the entire repository structurally (minLines=2, sampled JSON/CSV/SQL, stripped comments) while keeping 100% of elided functions restorable in .vicem/ledger.json.

name: vicem_read_baton
description: Reads the current .vicem/BATON.md handoff document and checks whether git HEAD has drifted from .vicem/baton.json. Use first when starting a handed-off session to inspect the goal, next steps, and Section 6 Diet Ledger index; do not use to create a baton (vicem_create_baton), restore an individual function body (vicem_rehydrate), or validate code diffs (vicem_check_guard). Read-only local operation (no auth, rate limits, or file mutations). Returns the full BATON.md text with isError=false; if git HEAD moved ahead of the baton commit, the call still succeeds and prepends a "> ⚠️ [STALENESS DRIFT WARNING]" banner with both commit hashes so you can check git diff before editing. Returns isError=true if .vicem/BATON.md does not exist.

name: vicem_rehydrate
description: Restores the exact, secret-redacted source code of a skeletonized function, method, or class from .vicem/ledger.json so you never write { ... } placeholders. Use after vicem_read_baton whenever you need to inspect or edit a symbol listed in .vicem/BATON.md Section 6 (Diet Ledger); do not use to read the full baton (vicem_read_baton), build a baton (vicem_create_baton), or check diff safety (vicem_check_guard). Parameter semantics: file_path (repo-relative POSIX path validated against path traversal) and symbol_name must match a ledger entry (camelCase filePath/symbolName aliases also accepted). Read-only lookup (no auth, rate limits, or disk writes): returns the redacted source code (isError=false), prepending a "// ⚠️ [STALENESS DRIFT WARNING]" comment if git HEAD or the on-disk file changed since snapshot. If the symbol is missing or was not skeletonized, returns isError=true with a not-found message so you can read the file directly.

file_path.description: Repository-relative POSIX file path as listed in .vicem/BATON.md Section 6 (e.g., "src/auth.ts" or "vicem.mjs").

symbol_name.description: Exact function, method, or class name to restore from .vicem/ledger.json (or comma-separated names like "parseCFamily,classifyCBlockHeader" for batch rehydration).

include_callees.description: When true, also restores 1-hop same-file functions called by symbol_name in a single round-trip.

name: vicem_check_guard
description: Verifies a code snippet or git diff against three safety checks: (1) SkeletonWriteGuard (blocks "{ ... }", "/* ... */", "⋮", or stub "pass" placeholders written into code files), (2) SecretCommitGuard (blocks raw API keys/credentials, leaked "‹REDACTED:...›" tokens, and baton markers), and (3) StalenessDriftGuard (flags git HEAD drift from .vicem/baton.json). Use before committing or finalizing edits to skeletonized files; do not use to read baton state (vicem_read_baton) or restore elided code (vicem_rehydrate). Parameter semantics: pass diff_text to inspect a specific unified diff or code snippet; omitting diff_text falls back to inspecting staged and unstaged working tree changes (git diff HEAD). Non-mutating read-only check (no auth, rate limits, or file overwrites): returns "OK: All 3 Safety Guards passed." (isError=false) when clean, or isError=true with per-violation findings and self-healing remediation prompts when a guard trips.

diff_text.description: Optional unified git diff or raw code snippet to validate. When omitted, defaults to inspecting live working tree and staged changes against HEAD (git diff HEAD).
